_doc: Gates table for the KOTOR 2 world. Generated by tools/build_gate_tables.py from research/story/token_candidates.json and research/gating/gating_plan.json; edit 'enabled', 'risk' or 'notes' to change a gate. tokens_needed = tokens of the family that must be held to pass.

gates.softlock_note: low: the Hawk is stolen at this point (ehstolen), so the shuttle is the only way forward; a token must be obtainable on Peragus/Citadel without the shuttle.
gates.door_rando_bypass: no: dialogue-driven StartNewModule; the shuttle bay doors (201TEL Airlock*, script-only) are not pooled doors.

gates.beat_name: Restoration Zone: Bao-Dur joins, shield network (TEL2)
gates.softlock_note: medium: Bao-Dur is also a forced companion join; withholding the join must not strand the party GUI (COMPANIONS.md 'hide, do not remove').
gates.door_rando_bypass: no for the join; the 232TEL force-field doors are script-only.

gates.beat_name: Hawk ramp and the 950COR holorecord: the open phase begins (TEL3)

hook.detail: dlg:holorec@950COR#E0 then sets 262TEL_Escape_Telos = 1 and LostJedi 30 (this is the unlock of the whole open phase)

gates.softlock_note: low if the token is required only to enter the ramp scene; tokens must not be placed in Telos modules reachable only after this gate.
gates.door_rando_bypass: partial: 261TEL<->262TEL is a scripted lift (dlg 261exit) and the ramp is a conversation; the 262TEL area has one pooled transition (AREAS door_access.csv).

gates.softlock_note: high: 301NAR/tr_ehawk_custom refuses takeoff without T3 once 300NAR_Bounty_Attack == 1; a held token must never block the T3 recovery chain (303NAR_T3_Mission).
gates.door_rando_bypass: partial: 351NAR is entered by dialogue; the hatch 351NAR TO_003EBO is a pooled one-way door.
gates.notes: Window B for Zez-Kai Ell (the yacht arc) opens here. If the Visquis attack closes window A while a token is missing, only the yacht route remains and it needs this arc to have started. Re-rated by the playthrough.

gates.beat_name: Mira / Hanharr fork and the Jekk'Jekk Tarr tunnels (NAR2)

hook.detail: 303NAR_Hanharr_Side 0/1 is written by dlg:305han@305NAR#R16/#R17, dlg:hanhboun@303NAR#R19, dlg:genodisc@305NAR#R6

gates.softlock_note: medium: either side must remain completable; the companion fork also removes a companion slot (COMPANIONS.md).
gates.door_rando_bypass: partial: 304NAR<->305NAR <-> 303NAR transitions are in the pool.

hook.target: ap_jedi_inc (the Jedi count +1 at the nodes of dlg zezkaiel, which the client points at it)
hook.detail: The conversation is never held back; the +1 on the Jedi count waits for the token (nss/k2ap_master.nss), then the dispatcher applies it.

gates.softlock_note: high if the Master's conversation is gated: 000_Jedi_Found >= 4 is required at Dantooine (605DAN/k_enter_605). The count must stay reachable.
gates.door_rando_bypass: no: the Master stands in the Flophouse (door Flophouse_Secret opened by 303NAR/a_unlock_sctdoor).
gates.notes: Gate BOTH spawn triggers (303NAR/a_zezconv and a_351zezconv). Reimplement them so he is created whenever the token is held and the Visquis audience has happened, even after the attack (to be confirmed in the game).

gates.beat_name: Mandalore's proving and the shuttle to Iziz (DXN1)
gates.softlock_note: medium: a_to_iziz is also the Mandalore companion join (forced).

gates.beat_name: Iziz alibi chain and the cantina meeting with Kavar (DXN2)
gates.softlock_note: high: End_First also unlocks the Hawk astrogation (galaxy2 lock while RETURN_DEST == 4 and End_First == 0).
gates.notes: 502OND_End_First also unlocks the map after the blockade detour: do not let the gate hold that flag.

gates.beat_name: Palace siege and Kavar: set-point 2 (DXN3, SP-OND)

hook.target: ap_jedi_inc (the Jedi count +1 at the nodes of dlg kavar, which the client points at it)
hook.detail: The conversation is never held back (the palace does not let the player leave); the +1 waits for the token.

gates.softlock_note: high: palace fight holds the player in the module (tr_no_exit / tr_kavar_prevent barks); never gate inside the siege.
gates.door_rando_bypass: no for the conversation; palace doors (ff_inner, ff_outer, door_puzzle) are script-only.

gates.beat_name: Khoonda war: pick a side, battle (DAN1)
gates.softlock_note: medium: three outcomes (B4); the Vrook chain (lostshad) depends on the battle result.

hook.target: ap_jedi_inc (the Jedi count +1 at the nodes of dlg vrook, which the client points at it)
hook.detail: The conversation is never held back; the +1 waits for the token.
journal relicpast 10/20/90; 610DAN is the sublevel (Disciple join for female PC)

gates.softlock_note: low: optional-ish beat; but 605DAN/k_enter_605 is also the endgame unlock (see FIN1) so it is safer to leave it ungated.
gates.notes: Duplicate of FIN1 (the same script, 605DAN/k_enter_605). Disabled by default; FIN1 alone covers the Enclave.

gates.beat_name: Korriban landing and Sith Academy entry (KOR1)

hook.detail: opens the Academy entrance door; held back, the door stays shut and the conversation can come round again

gates.softlock_note: medium: the academy locks behind the PC; the chain is linear until Sion.
gates.door_rando_bypass: no for the story steps; 701KOR<->702KOR door is pooled (KorribanTempleDoor is script-only).

gates.softlock_note: high: needed for 000_Jedi_Found >= 4; the trigger fires once per local flag 40 on vash_container.
gates.notes: Needs a second wrapper on 701KOR/tr_exit702_end so the Academy door stays unlocked until 702KOR_Vash == 1.

gates.softlock_note: medium: leaving the academy depends on this scene.

hook.detail: once 650DAN_Rebuilt != 0 the trigger starts dlg encl_cam, whose E1 runs a_open_door('door_650'); the gate holds that branch back. k_enter_605 only sets Rebuilt and the Enclave_Door of the 605 sublevel, so it is left alone.

gates.softlock_note: low: vanilla already requires the count; the token gate would stack on top.
gates.door_rando_bypass: no: unlocking script; the Enclave door is script-only.

gates.beat_name: Telos Academy assault: Kreia and Atris, the sisters, Atris phases, Kreia's projection (FIN2)
Citadel under attack: Mandalore, Visas forced, party GUI, to the Ravager (FIN3)
Trayus Core: Kreia fight and end (FIN4, the goal)

hook.detail: goal event: 904MAL/a_end_game at reply R112 -> GBL_GAME_COMPLETE

gates.softlock_note: low: end of the game; tokens must be obtainable before Malachor.
gates.door_rando_bypass: no (903MAL->904MAL one-way, excluded from any shuffle).
